about: What people in the North Meadows say. The first entry whose "when" is true is used; an entry with no "when" always matches, so put it last. {name} is the player's name; {@some-id} is someone's name.

say: MY, MY, {name}! THE CHICKS ARE HOME AND {@forest-imp} IS SAFE.
YOU'RE THE KINDEST HELPER THESE MEADOWS HAVE EVER SEEN. HAVE A CUP OF TEA WITH ME ANY TIME!
HELLO, DEAR! LOOKING FOR LITTLE CHICKS?
I HEARD A TINY PEEP UNDER THE PINK BLOSSOM TREES, JUST SOUTH OF MY MEADOW.
THE LITTLE ONE FROM THE WOODS IS LOST? OH DEAR.
LOOK FOR THINGS WITH A STAR OVER THEM, {name}. CLUES ALWAYS SPARKLE!
WELCOME TO THE NORTH MEADOWS, {name}! I'M {@north-granny}.
HOP ACROSS THE STEPPING STONES TO TREASURE ISLE, AND TRY FISHING OFF THE LITTLE PIER BY THE LILY POND.
HI {name}! I'M {@cat-nimbus}. I LOVE WATCHING THE CLOUDS FLOAT OVER THE BLOSSOM TREES.
THAT ONE LOOKS LIKE A BUNNY. AND THAT ONE LOOKS LIKE ME!
THE MUSHROOM RING IS FULL OF SECRETS. KEEP YOUR EYES OPEN, {name}!
